evals.expected_output: Run AutoCAD/pywin32 preflight, produce an explicit drawing plan, use scripts/acad_draw.py or acad_session.py to create the rectangle and four circles, save DWG, and recommend acad_review.py to check entities and bounds.

evals.expected_output: Use batch read-only opening and acad_review.py, preserve the originals, record errors per file, output a JSON/CSV summary, and explain that COM operations run serially.

evals.prompt: Create an AutoCAD .NET plugin that can be loaded with NETLOAD and provides a command to generate several circles and text. Use official documentation and GitHub examples where possible.
